name: Working on an alternative is not pursuing the retired concept

events.text: The summary is out of date. Automatic renewal is retired. Automatic renewal can charge a customer without fresh consent. I will not work toward automatic renewal.

Next, I'll continue with reservation expiry instead of automatic renewal. I will design explicit opt-in rather than automatic renewal. I will build a fresh consent flow in place of automatic renewal. I will design a replacement for automatic renewal. I will consider reservation expiry (automatic renewal is retired — no longer part of our work).
